_comment: Sample data from the prototype, NOT verified: schedules and powers are approximate. Replaced by EiBi in phase 2.

stations.name: Radio Martí
stations.note: US Spanish-language service aimed at Cuba. From Santiago it arrives from the north, over a long path across the Caribbean.

stations.name: Radio Rebelde
stations.note: Cuban national network, on the 60 m tropical band.

stations.name: Radio Habana Cuba
stations.note: Cuba's international service, broadcasting in time blocks.

stations.name: WRMI Radio Miami
stations.note: Private shortwave station that leases airtime to many programmes.

stations.name: WBCQ The Planet
stations.note: Private shortwave station in Maine with varied, very local programming.

stations.name: CHU Canada
stations.note: Time and standard-frequency signal of the National Research Council of Canada.

stations.name: WWV
stations.note: NIST time and standard-frequency signal, transmitted from Colorado.

stations.name: WWV
stations.note: Same station on 15 MHz. Shares the frequency with WWVH and BPM.

stations.name: WWVH
stations.note: WWV's sister station in Hawaii. Tell them apart by the voice of the time announcements.

stations.name: BPM China
stations.note: Time signal of China's National Time Service Center.
